generic.Required fields populated and valid: Talks date, participants, and outcome fields are complete on the matter record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged talks matches the count of pre-arbitration settlement discussions held
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Discussion outcome is recorded with the talks date and participant list
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Talks ending in continued impasse are logged with a follow-up strategy
generic.Test population: Sample of matters with pre-arbitration talks conducted during the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if talks are logged with date, participants, and outcome
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate continued impasse to the Litigation Manager for arbitration planning
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Talks are complete only when conducted within authorized settlement parameters
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system and iManage

steps.title: Open the matter record in Legal matter management/e-billing system to begin the task
sop: Open the matter record for this matter in Legal matter management/e-billing system.
Review the current status and details relevant to reinsurance disputes proceeding to pre-arbitration settlement talks.
Done when the matter record is open and current details are reviewed.
verify: Check that the matter record was opened and current details reviewed.
Pass when the matter record's status and details are confirmed current.

steps.title: Prepare a settlement position summarizing the assessment
sop: Summarize the assessment of the disputed cession.
Prepare the settlement position before talks begin.
Done when the settlement position summary is prepared.
verify: Check the matter file for the prepared settlement position.
Pass when the position summarizes the disputed cession assessment.

steps.title: Conduct settlement discussions within authorized parameters
sop: Conduct discussions with the reinsurer's legal counsel.
Confirm all offers remain within authorized settlement parameters.
Done when discussions are conducted within authorized parameters.
verify: Check the discussion notes for parameter compliance.
Pass when no offer exceeded the authorized parameters.

steps.title: Document the discussion outcome including tentative resolution or impasse
sop: Document whether the discussion reached a tentative resolution.
Note any continued impasse points.
Done when the discussion outcome is documented.
verify: Review the documented outcome for resolution or impasse detail.
Pass when the outcome is clearly stated.

steps.title: Record the talks date, participants, and outcome
sop: Enter the talks date, participant list, and outcome onto the matter record.
Confirm the entry matches the documented discussion.
Done when talks date, participants, and outcome are recorded.
verify: Reopen the matter record and check the talks fields.
Pass when date, participants, and outcome are all present.

steps.title: Confirm the task's completion criterion is met
sop: Review the completed work against the required completion criterion for this task.
Correct any gap identified before marking the task complete.
Done when pre-arbitration settlement talks are logged with date, participants, and outcome.
verify: Check the matter record against the completion criterion.
Pass when pre-arbitration settlement talks are logged with date, participants, and outcome.

generic.Defined scope/population: Reinsurance arbitrations requiring panel selection per applicable procedures
generic.In-scope period: Panels constituted in the current reporting period
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Panel member names, roles, and disclosure fields are complete on the matter record
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of panels constituted matches the count of arbitrations requiring one
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Constituted panel members and constitution date are recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Panel members without a disclosure statement are logged as exceptions
generic.Test population: Sample of matters with a constituted panel during the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if the panel is recorded with member names, roles, and disclosure statements
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate missing disclosure statements to Litigation Counsel before proceeding
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Selection is complete only when each member's independence is confirmed
generic.Evidence location: Matter record in the legal matter management system and iManage

steps.title: Open the matter record in Legal matter management/e-billing system to begin the task
sop: Open the matter record for this matter in Legal matter management/e-billing system.
Review the current status and details relevant to reinsurance arbitrations requiring panel selection per applicable procedures.
Done when the matter record is open and current details are reviewed.
verify: Check that the matter record was opened and current details reviewed.
Pass when the matter record's status and details are confirmed current.

steps.title: Confirm whether ARIAS-US or a bespoke clause governs panel selection
sop: Review the treaty for ARIAS-US procedures or a bespoke arbitration clause.
Confirm which procedure governs panel selection for this dispute.
Done when the governing procedure is confirmed.
verify: Check the matter record for the confirmed governing procedure.
Pass when the procedure cited matches the treaty's arbitration clause.

steps.title: Coordinate appointment of the party arbitrators and umpire
sop: Coordinate the appointment of each party arbitrator per the applicable procedure.
Coordinate the appointment of the umpire once party arbitrators are named.
Done when all panel members are appointed.
verify: Check the matter record for the appointed panel members.
Pass when party arbitrators and umpire are all named.

steps.title: Confirm each panel member's independence and disclosure statement
sop: Request an independence disclosure statement from each panel member.
Confirm each statement is on file before the panel proceeds.
Done when all disclosure statements are on file.
verify: Check the matter file for each panel member's disclosure statement.
Pass when every panel member has a disclosure statement on file.

steps.title: Record the constituted panel members and constitution date
sop: Enter the constituted panel member names and roles onto the matter record.
Enter the panel constitution date.
Done when panel members and constitution date are recorded.
verify: Reopen the matter record and check the panel fields.
Pass when member names, roles, and constitution date are all present.

steps.title: Confirm the task's completion criterion is met
sop: Review the completed work against the required completion criterion for this task.
Correct any gap identified before marking the task complete.
Done when panel constitution is recorded with member names, roles, and disclosure statements on file.
verify: Check the matter record against the completion criterion.
Pass when panel constitution is recorded with member names, roles, and disclosure statements on file.
